#!/usr/bin/env python3

from app.dependencies import PayloadSink
from app.service import ingest

# Test multiple frames
def test_multiple_frames():
    sink = PayloadSink()
    # Frame 1: length=2, payload="ab"
    # Frame 2: length=2, payload="cd"
    payload = b'\x00\x02ab\x00\x02cd'
    receipt = ingest(payload, sink, framed=True)
    assert sink.items == [b"ab", b"cd"]
    assert receipt.stored == 4
    print("Multiple frames test passed")

# Test partial frame handling
def test_partial_frame():
    sink = PayloadSink()
    # Frame 1: length=2, payload="ab"
    # Partial frame data
    payload = b'\x00\x02ab\x00\x03abc'  # Should only process first frame
    receipt = ingest(payload, sink, framed=True)
    assert sink.items == [b"ab"]
    assert receipt.stored == 2
    print("Partial frame test passed")

# Test empty payload
def test_empty_payload():
    sink = PayloadSink()
    payload = b''
    receipt = ingest(payload, sink, framed=True)
    assert sink.items == []
    assert receipt.stored == 0
    print("Empty payload test passed")

# Test raw mode still works
def test_raw_mode():
    sink = PayloadSink()
    payload = b"hello"
    receipt = ingest(payload, sink, framed=False)
    assert sink.items == [b"hello"]
    assert receipt.stored == 5
    print("Raw mode test passed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_multiple_frames()
    test_partial_frame()
    test_empty_payload()
    test_raw_mode()
    print("All edge case tests passed!")
